messages:
Mina Park: hey folks, accepted the org invite but I only see public repos and get 404 on eng-core/runtime. also trying to enable passkey 2FA and my phone errors with 'platform not supported'. who should I ping?

onboarding-bot: welcome to Redwood! :tada: Typical causes: SSO not completed, membership type, or email mismatch. See https://docs.redwood.example/devex/github-access. Ping @DevEx-Raj for org checks.

DevEx-Raj: @Mina Park what's your GitHub handle?

Mina Park: minap-k

DevEx-Raj: quick check shows your membership is "member" but sso_required: true. That will cause repo 404s until you authorize SSO. Try visiting https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference/sso and click the Authorize button.

Mina Park: I went there but no banner appeared. my primary GitHub email is my personal one; the invite was to mina.park@redwood.com. could that be it?

IT-Hannah: if the invite targeted your work email and your GitHub account doesn't have it, the invite might not link properly. Add the work email to your GitHub account and verify it, then accept the invite from that email. If you already did accept, let us know and we can re-trigger SAML from the IdP.

Mina Park: i had added the work email and clicked the invite link. still no banner.

DevEx-Raj: okay I re-sent the SAML authorization from the IdP and pushed you into team eng-core-dev (write) as well. Try: 1) log out of github.com, 2) open an incognito window, 3) visit https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference and accept SAML.

Mina Park: did that and GitHub asked me to enroll a passkey which failed with 'platform not supported'. I canceled and enrolled TOTP instead, then completed SSO.

Taylor: FYI Pixel webauthn support is hit-or-miss on older Android versions. Enrolling TOTP is a good fallback. IT can send YubiKeys if you want a hardware option.

Mina Park: after SSO I still get 403 when trying to push: "remote: Permission to redwood-inference/eng-core/runtime.git denied to minap-k."

Benito: I just granted repo write and verified you're in eng-core-dev. 403 after a role/permission change is usually cached credentials. On mac: `git credential-osxkeychain erase` or on Windows use credential manager to remove saved GitHub creds, then `gh auth login`.

Mina Park: cleared credentials and re-auth'd, push succeeded. thanks!

IT-Hannah: opened IT ticket RW-1018 to track the passkey/platform issue and added a note to onboarding steps recommending TOTP for older phones and the YubiKey request flow. If you'd like a YubiKey, reply to the ticket with your shipping address.

Mina Park: thanks everyone! quick Q: where is the list of default teams by role?

DevEx-Raj: https://docs.redwood.example/people/onboarding has the default team mappings. Welcome aboard :wave:

Mina Park: awesome, appreciate the speedy help :smile:
